meta.title: 第34讲 · 不定式① 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身认识非谓语动词与不定式 → 六大句法功能对号入座 → 作主语：三单与 it 形式主语（for/of 之争）→ 作表语 · 定语 · 状语 → 作宾语：十组动词与 it 形式宾语 → 作宾补（上）：sb. to do 三句口诀 → 作宾补（下）：省 to 与被动还原 → 综合验收（共 8 关 · 52 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：认识非谓语动词与不定式
nodes.explain:
从本讲起进入非谓语动词大板块。非谓语动词是动词的「非谓语形式」，在句中不能单独作谓语，一共三种：不定式 (to do)、动名词 (doing)、分词 (-ing / -ed)。本讲先攻第一种——不定式①。

不定式的构成只有两条，一看就会：

构成格式例句
基本形式to + 动词原形Mom told the boy to play in the park. 妈妈告诉男孩在公园里玩。
否定形式not + to do（not 放 to 前面）Mom told the boy not to play in the street. 妈妈告诉男孩不要在街上玩。

不定式有三大特征，决定了它怎么用：

① 没有人称和数的变化，不能作谓语——主语再怎么变，它都不跟着变；

② 保留动词的特点——可以带自己的宾语和状语：It is interesting to play with snow in winter.（play 带着自己的宾语 snow）；

③ 兼有名词、形容词、副词的特征——所以能充当主语、宾语、宾补、表语、定语、状语六种成分，这是本讲的地图。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem: 非谓语动词包括哪三种形式？
options: 不定式 (to do)、动名词 (doing)、分词 (-ing / -ed)
general_qs.answer: A. 不定式 (to do)、动名词 (doing)、分词 (-ing / -ed)
general_qs.explain: 非谓语动词 = 不能单独作谓语的动词形式，三兄弟：to do、doing、分词。B 是时态，C 是句子成分，都不是它的分类。

general_qs.stem: 动词不定式的基本构成是？
general_qs.explain: 不定式 = to + 动词原形：to play、to go、to read。to 后面永远是最光的动词原形，不加 -s、-ing、-ed。

general_qs.stem: Mom told the boy ________ in the street.（不要在街上玩，用 play 补全）
general_qs.explain: 否定形式 = not + to do：not to play。not 一定要放在 to 的前面，这是不定式否定唯一的写法。

general_qs.stem: 关于不定式，下面哪句说法是对的？
options: 不定式可以单独作句子的谓语
不定式没有人称和数的变化，不能单独作谓语
主语是三单时，不定式也要加 -s
不定式就是谓语动词的另一种写法
general_qs.answer: B. 不定式没有人称和数的变化，不能单独作谓语
general_qs.explain: 不定式是「非谓语」，天生的规矩就是不作谓语、不随人称和数变化。A / D 死于弄错身份；C 死于「无三单变化」。

general_qs.stem: Nice ________ (meet) you!
general_qs.explain: 不定式基本形式 to + 原形 → to meet。不定式还保留动词特点，后面能带自己的宾语：to meet you。

memory.front: 非谓语动词有哪三种？不定式怎么构成、怎么变成否定？
memory.back:
非谓语动词：不定式 to do / 动名词 doing / 分词 -ing、-ed，都不能单独作谓语
不定式：to + 动词原形（Mom told the boy to play in the park.）
否定：not + to do，not 放 to 前（Mom told the boy not to play in the street.）
三大特征：无人称数变化 · 保留动词特点 · 兼有名词/形容词/副词特征

nodes.title: ② 不定式的六大句法功能：对号入座
nodes.explain:
不定式一身兼三性——名词、形容词、副词，所以能在句子里干六种活。做题先找「它在谁后面」：

功能位置信号讲义例句
主语谓语前面，句子开头To see is to believe. 眼见为实。
宾语及物动词后面I want to go home. / He likes to play basketball.
宾补宾语后面，补说宾语做什么He advised me to lose weight. / The teacher asked me to clean the blackboard.
表语系动词 (is / am / are…) 后面My work is to clean the room every day. / My dream is to travel around the world.
定语名词后面，修饰名词Have you got anything to say? / I have something important to tell you.
状语修饰形容词或动词，表原因、目的I'm sorry to trouble you. 很抱歉麻烦你 / To pass the exam, he studied very hard. 为了通过考试

记法：谓前是主，动后是宾，系后是表，宾后补足，名后修饰是定语，其余多是状语。下面六题把这六种成分各认一遍脸。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：六大功能对号入座

general_qs.stem: To speak English is not easy for us. 中 To speak English 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 不定式站在谓语 is 前面、干「谁/什么」的活——讲英语这件事不容易 → 主语。真正干活的是它，所以谓语还用三单（后面第③关细讲）。

general_qs.stem: He likes to play basketball. 中 to play basketball 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: like 是及物动词，喜欢「什么」？喜欢打篮球这件事 → to play basketball 作宾语。

general_qs.stem: The teacher asked me to clean the blackboard. 中 to clean the blackboard 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 站在宾语 me 后面，补说「我干什么」→ 宾语补足语。擦黑板的人是 me，me 和 clean 是逻辑上的主谓关系。

general_qs.stem: My work is to clean the room every day. 中 to clean the room 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 系动词 is 后面说明主语 work 的具体内容 → 表语。见到 is + to do，基本就是表语。

general_qs.stem: Have you got anything to say? 中 to say 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 跟在名词 anything 后面修饰它——「要说的」事 → 定语。不定式作定语永远后置，别把它当宾语。

general_qs.stem: To pass the exam, he studied very hard. 中 To pass the exam 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 句首的不定式说明 studied hard 的目的——为了通过考试 → 目的状语。它既不当主语（真正主语是 he），也不跟在名词后面。

nodes.title: ③ 不定式作主语：三单与 it 形式主语
nodes.explain:
1）不定式作主语，谓语用第三人称单数——不定式代表「一件事」，一件事就是三单：

To learn from each other is necessary. 互相学习是有必要的。

2）it 作形式主语：不定式放句首当主语容易头重脚轻，常让 it 先占位，真正的主语挪到句末：

It is necessary to learn from each other.
形式主语          真正的主语

3）It + be + adj. + for / of sb. + to do——for 还是 of，看形容词说的是谁：

形容词说什么常用词例句
for事情的性质（对某人而言）important / necessary / difficult / convenientIt's important for us to protect the environment. / It is difficult for beginners to master this skill.
of人的品质（夸人 / 贬人）kind / nice / brave / careless / clever / politeIt is kind of you to help me with my work. / It is brave of him to speak up in front of so many people.

判断法：把 sb. 拿出来造句 sb. is + adj.——说得通用 of（You are kind. √），说不通用 for（Us is important. ✗）。

记法：夸人用 of，说事用 for。下面就是课堂练习 1，四空全是 for / of 之争。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1：for 还是 of

general_qs.stem: To learn from each other ________ (be) necessary.
general_qs.explain: 不定式作主语表示「一件事」，谓语用三单 → is。不定式自己永远不变形，变的是后面的谓语动词。

general_qs.stem: It is necessary ________ people to have food and water every day.（课堂练习 1，填 for / of）
general_qs.explain: necessary 说的是「事」——每天有吃喝这件事有必要，不是夸人 → for。检验：People is necessary 说不通。

general_qs.stem: It's very convenient ________ us to buy train tickets on the Internet.（课堂练习 1，填 for / of）
general_qs.explain: convenient（方便）说的是网购买票这件事的性质，不是夸我们人方便 → for。

general_qs.stem: It's careless ________ you to make lots of mistakes.（课堂练习 1，填 for / of）
general_qs.explain: careless（粗心）说的是「你」的品质 → of。检验：You are careless. 完全说得通。

general_qs.stem: It's very nice ________ you to get me two tickets.（课堂练习 1，填 for / of）
general_qs.explain: nice（真好）在夸「你」人好 → of。检验：You are nice. √。课堂练习 1 整组答案：for, for, of, of——前两空说事，后两空夸人。

general_qs.stem: It is difficult ________ beginners to master this skill.（填 for / of）
general_qs.explain: difficult 说的是「掌握这项技能」这件事难，不是初学者这个人难 → for。

general_qs.stem: 什么时候用 of sb.？
options: 形容词夸 / 贬的是「人」的品质，能说 sb. is adj. 就用 of
形容词说明「事」的性质时就用 of
只要主语是人就用 of
of 和 for 意思一样，随便换
general_qs.answer: A. 形容词夸 / 贬的是「人」的品质，能说 sb. is adj. 就用 of
general_qs.explain: of 管人、for 管事。B 死于方向反了（说事用 for）；C 死于「是人不行，得形容词在说他」；D 死于一字之差意思两样。

memory.front: It is + adj. + for/of sb. + to do，for 和 of 怎么选？
memory.back:
of：形容词说的是人的品质——kind / nice / brave / careless / clever / polite
检验：sb. is adj. 说得通 → It is kind of you to help me.
for：形容词说的是事的性质——important / necessary / difficult / convenient
It's important for us to protect the environment.
一句话：夸人用 of，说事用 for。

nodes.title: ④ 不定式作表语 · 定语 · 状语
nodes.explain:
作表语：不定式放在系动词之后，说明主语的具体内容或目的：

My work is to clean the room every day. 我的工作就是每天打扫这间屋子。/ My dream is to travel around the world. 我的梦想是环游世界。

主表互换：不定式作表语时，通常可以和主语换位置，意思不变——

A good way of learning English is to listen to English songs.
= To listen to English songs is a good way of learning English.

另外两种成分也顺手练熟：

作定语（名词后面修饰名词）：Have you got anything to say? / I have something important to tell you.——注意 something 是不定代词，修饰它的 important 和 to tell you 都得放它后面。

作状语（修饰形容词或动词）：I'm sorry to trouble you.（原因——为什么抱歉）/ To pass the exam, he studied very hard.（目的——为了通过考试）

记法：系后是表可互换，名后是定紧相随，句首目的、sorry 后原因，都是状语来点缀。
nodes.qs_label: 练习：表语 · 定语 · 状语各来一题

general_qs.stem: My dream is ________ (travel) around the world.
general_qs.explain: 系动词 is 后面作表语 → to travel。表语说明 dream 的具体内容：环游世界这个梦想。

general_qs.stem: 同义互换：To listen to English songs is a good way of learning English. 下面哪句意思相同？
options: A good way of learning English is to listen to English songs.
A good way of learning English is listen to English songs.
A good way to learning English is listening to English songs.
A good way of learning English is to listening to English songs.
general_qs.answer: A. A good way of learning English is to listen to English songs.
general_qs.explain: 主表互换：不定式表语可以和主语位置对调，to do 形式不变。B 死于 is 后少了 to；C 死于 way to do 才对、且表语丢了 to；D 死于 to 后面不能接 -ing。

general_qs.stem: Have you got anything ________ (say)?
general_qs.explain: 不定式放在 anything 后面作定语——「要说的」话。不定式作定语永远后置。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪句是正确的？
options: I have important something to tell you.
I have something important to tell you.
I have something to tell important you.
I have something important telling you.
general_qs.answer: B. I have something important to tell you.
general_qs.explain: something 是不定代词，修饰它的形容词 important 和不定式 to tell you 都要放它后面。A 死于形容词跑到 something 前面；C 死于把 important 塞进了宾语；D 死于定语位置用了 telling。

general_qs.stem: I'm sorry to trouble you. 中 to trouble 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 它说明抱歉的原因——「麻烦你」这件事让我抱歉 → 原因状语，修饰形容词 sorry。

general_qs.stem: ________ (pass) the exam, he studied very hard.
general_qs.explain: 句首不定式作目的状语：为了通过考试，他学习很努力。句首要大写 → To pass。不能写成 Pass（没 to 就不是不定式了）。

nodes.title: ⑤ 不定式作宾语：十组动词与 it 形式宾语
nodes.explain:
1）作动词的宾语：I decided to change my eating habit. 我决定改变我的饮食习惯。

哪些动词后面请 to do 当宾语？讲义列了十组，考试专挑这里挖坑：

动词 + to do意思动词 + to do意思
wish / hope to do希望agree to do同意
expect to do期待refuse to do拒绝
want / would like to do想要promise to do承诺
manage to do设法完成learn to do学会
decide to do决定plan to do计划

2）find / think 后用 it 作形式宾语：真正的宾语（不定式）太长，先让 it 占座，把真宾语挪到句末：

I find it easy to read English every day.
        形式宾语  真正的宾语
Do you think it possible to finish the work within one day?

记法：宾语太长它先坐，it 占座真宾语靠后站；十组动词接 to do，一个萝卜一个坑。

general_qs.stem: I expect ________ at home on weekends.
general_qs.explain: expect（期待）是十组动词之一，后接 to do → to stay。A 死于丢了 to；C 死于 expect 不接 -ing；D 死于 to 后面多事。

general_qs.stem: He ________ to live a simple life.
general_qs.explain: 四个动词里只有 hope 能直接接 to do（hope to do 希望）。A / D 死于要先接人——advise sb. to do / allow sb. to do；B 死于 suggest 后面接 doing，不接 to do。

general_qs.stem: He wants ________ (play) basketball with us after school.
general_qs.explain: want / would like 都接 to do 想要做 → to play。I want to go home. / He likes to play basketball. 是同一套路。

general_qs.stem: I promised ________ (not be) late again.
general_qs.explain: 两步：promise 接 to do；否定形式 not 放 to 前 → not to be。承诺「不再迟到」= promised not to be late。

general_qs.stem: I find it easy ________ (read) English every day.
general_qs.explain: find + it + adj. + to do：it 是形式宾语占座，真正的宾语 to read English every day 站句末，easy 作宾补。

general_qs.stem: Do you think it possible ________ the work within one day?
general_qs.explain: think + it + adj. + to do 形式宾语结构 → to finish the work。真正的宾语永远以 to do 身份站在句末。

general_qs.stem: I find it easy to read English every day. 这句里的 it 指什么？
options: 指读英语这件事——真正的宾语 to read English every day
general_qs.answer: A. 指读英语这件事——真正的宾语 to read English every day
general_qs.explain: it 是形式宾语，替真宾语 to read English every day 占座。宾语太长站前面会把句子压歪，所以让它往后站、it 先顶上。

memory.front: 哪十组动词后接 to do 作宾语？find / think 后的 it 是什么？
memory.back:
十组动词接 to do：wish/hope 希望、expect 期待、want/would like 想要、manage 设法完成、decide 决定、agree 同意、refuse 拒绝、promise 承诺、learn 学会、plan 计划
形式宾语：find / think + it + adj. + to do，it 占位，真宾语在后
I find it easy to read English every day.

nodes.title: ⑥ 不定式作宾补（上）：V + sb. + to do
nodes.explain:
不定式作宾补（宾语补足语）：与宾语有逻辑上的主谓关系——He advised me to lose weight. 里，是「me」去 lose weight，me 就是 lose 的逻辑主语。格式：及物动词 + 宾语 (sb. / sth.) + to do。

My parents don't allow me to watch TV on school nights. 我父母不允许我在上学的晚上看电视。/ My mother encourages me to develop the habit of independent thinking. 我妈妈鼓励我养成独立思考的习惯。

哪些动词这样用？讲义三句口诀，九个词全在里面：

① 建议鼓励少命令：advise / encourage / order sb. to do sth.
② 允许警告教要求：allow / warn / teach / ask sb. to do sth.
③ 告诉邀请作宾补：tell / invite sb. to do sth.

He advised me to lose weight. 他建议我减肥 / The teacher asked me to clean the blackboard. 老师让我擦黑板 / invite sb. to do sth. 邀请某人做某事（或参加某活动）。

否定把 not 放到 to 前面：The teacher told them not to make so much noise. 老师叫他们别那么吵。

记法：三句口诀背熟，九个动词见一个认一个——「建议鼓励少命令，允许警告教要求，告诉邀请作宾补」。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（中）：sb. to do 宾补

general_qs.stem: My parents don't allow me ________ (watch) TV on school nights.
general_qs.explain: allow 在口诀第二句「允许警告教要求」里 → allow sb. to do sth. → to watch。

general_qs.stem: The teacher asked me ________ the blackboard.
general_qs.explain: ask sb. to do sth. 要求某人做某事 → to clean。A 死于 ask 不是省 to 的使役动词（那是 make / let / have 的待遇，下一关讲）。

general_qs.stem: The teacher told them ________ make so much noise.
general_qs.explain: 宾补是 tell sb. to do 的否定：把 not 放到 to 前 → told them not to make。A / C 死于宾补要不定式、不能塞进一个句子；B 死于光有 not 丢了 to。

general_qs.stem: My mother encourages me ________ (develop) the habit of independent thinking.
general_qs.explain: encourage 在口诀第一句「建议鼓励少命令」里 → encourage sb. to do sth. → to develop。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪组动词都接 sb. to do 作宾补？
general_qs.explain: A 组全在「建议鼓励少命令 + 允许警告教要求」两句口诀里。B 组是使役 / 感官动词，宾补省 to（下一关）；C 组后面接 -ing；D 组直接接 to do 作宾语，中间不许插 sb.

general_qs.stem:
--- What did Mr Brown say?
--- He invited me ________ to his birthday party.
general_qs.explain: invite 在口诀第三句「告诉邀请作宾补」里 → invite sb. to do sth. 邀请某人做某事 → to come。

memory.front: 接 sb. to do 作宾补的三句口诀？否定怎么放？
memory.back:
建议鼓励少命令：advise / encourage / order
允许警告教要求：allow / warn / teach / ask
告诉邀请作宾补：tell / invite
格式：V + sb. + to do（He advised me to lose weight.）
否定：not 放 to 前——tell sb. not to do

nodes.title: ⑦ 不定式作宾补（下）：感官使役省 to，被动还原
nodes.explain:
第二类宾补换个画风：感官动词 / 使役动词 + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to 的不定式）：

类别动词例句
使役动词make / let / have（help sb. (to) do 带不带 to 都行）The boss made the workers work 14 hours a day. 老板让工人们一天工作 14 小时。
感官动词see / watch / notice / hearI often see him play by the river. 我经常看见他在河边玩。

王牌考点——变被动，to 还原：这些动词变被动语态时，省掉的 to 必须请回来：

（主动）I often see him play by the river. →（被动）He is often seen to play by the river.

（主动）The boss made the workers work 14 hours a day. →（被动）The workers were made to work 14 hours a day by the boss.

记法：主动省 to，被动还 to——「省了的 to，被动要还」。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（下）：省 to 与还原

general_qs.stem: I saw him ________ out of the room.
general_qs.explain: see 是感官动词，宾补用不带 to 的原形 → see him go。B / C 死于宾补位置不接过去 / 完成形式；D 死于宾补不是谓语，没有三单。

general_qs.stem: Though he had often made his little sister ________, today he was made ________ by his little sister.
general_qs.explain: 一题双考：前半句主动，make sb. do 省 to → cry；后半句被动 was made，省掉的 to 必须还原 → to cry。C 死于后半句忘了还原，D 死于前半句多带了 to。

general_qs.stem: The boss made the workers ________ (work) 14 hours a day.
general_qs.explain: make 是使役动词，主动句宾补用光杆原形 → work。要是写成 to work 就把使役动词当成 ask 那一伙了。

general_qs.stem: The workers were made ________ (work) 14 hours a day by the boss.
general_qs.explain: 同一句话变被动：were made 后面 to 必须还原 → to work。主动省 to、被动还 to，本讲王牌考点。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪个动词的宾补不带 to？
general_qs.explain: let 是使役动词，let sb. do 让某人做。A / B / D 都在「教要求、告诉邀请」口诀里，老老实实接 sb. to do。

general_qs.stem: He was often seen ________ (play) by the river.
general_qs.explain: I often see him play by the river. 的被动版：was seen 后 to 还原 → to play。别看它被动了就光杆原形跟上。

general_qs.stem: hear / watch / notice 属于哪类动词？宾补怎么处理？
options: 感官动词，宾补省 to（宾语后接动词原形）
使役动词，宾补必须带 to
接 sb. to do 的动词
general_qs.answer: A. 感官动词，宾补省 to（宾语后接动词原形）
general_qs.explain: see / watch / notice / hear 四个感官动词都是「看见 / 听见整个过程」，宾语后接原形。B 死于类别认错；C 死于它们恰恰不带 to；D 死于 -ing 是「正在进行」的用法，不是这里的规定。

memory.front: 感官 / 使役动词作宾补省 to——哪些词？变被动后呢？
memory.back:
使役：make / let / have（help sb. (to) do 带不带都行）
感官：see / watch / notice / hear
主动：I often see him play by the river.（省 to）
被动：He is often seen to play by the river.（to 还原）
The workers were made to work 14 hours a day.
一句话：主动省 to，被动还 to

nodes.title: ⑧ 综合验收：七关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面七关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：不定式构成与否定（第①关）· 六大成分识别（第②关）· 三单与 for / of 之争（第③关）· 主表互换与定语状语（第④关）· 十组 to do 动词（第⑤关）· sb. to do 三句口诀（第⑥关）· 省 to 与被动还原（第⑦关）。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: It's very kind ________ you to help me with my work.
general_qs.explain: kind（好心）夸的是「你」的品质——You are kind. 说得通 → of。回第③关：夸人用 of，说事用 for。

general_qs.stem: To learn English well ________ (be) not easy for us.
general_qs.explain: 不定式作主语代表「一件事」，谓语用三单 → is。回第③关第一格。

general_qs.stem: He decided ________ (change) his eating habit.
general_qs.explain: decide 是十组动词之一，接 to do → to change。回第⑤关：一个萝卜一个坑。

general_qs.stem: I would like ________ home now.
general_qs.explain: want / would like 接 to do 想要做 → to go。C 死于 would like 不接 -ing。回第⑤关。

general_qs.stem: My mother asked me ________ (not play) computer games at night.
general_qs.explain: ask sb. to do sth. 的否定：not 放 to 前 → not to play。回第⑥关：三句口诀 + not 提前。

general_qs.stem: He was often heard ________ (sing) in the next room.
general_qs.explain: hear 是感官动词，主动省 to（hear him sing），变被动 to 还原 → was heard to sing。回第⑦关：主动省 to，被动还 to。

general_qs.stem: My job is ________ (look) after the baby.
general_qs.explain: 系动词 is 后面作表语 → to look。和 My work is to clean the room. 同款。回第④关：系后是表可互换。

general_qs.stem: I have a lot of homework ________ (do).
general_qs.explain: 不定式跟在名词 homework 后面修饰它——「要做的」作业 → 定语。和 I have something important to tell you. 同款。回第④关：名后是定。
